text:
maya: Heads-up — onboarding 'Orchid' next week, APAC edge footprint (sin/tok). Need a cross-cloud account bootstrap + quota increase preflight. I sketched a minimal checklist below, please pick owners. Deadline: Wed EOD PT (request must be in by Tue to get approvals).

maya: Checklist (high level)
1) AWS: account setup, billing link, VPCs, ENI & IP quotas, EC2 GPU quotas (A100/G5/T4), NAT throughput planning, S3 lifecycle policy.
2) GCP: org node, billing account link, projects, service accounts, regional GPU quotas (A100), subnet allocation, private GKE clusters, flow logs.
3) Azure: subscription & RG creation, quota increases for ND A100 SKUs, accelerated networking limits, load balancer SNAT pool sizing.
4) IAM & tags: standard tags, admin service accounts, least-privilege roles, domain-restricted sharing.
5) Networking: VPC peerings, VPNs to customer, egress NAT, reserved IPs for endpoints.
6) Observability & security: VPC flow logs, guardrails, KMS setup, audit logs export.

sam: I can own AWS quotas and VPC prep. Quick questions: how many A100s do they want initially?

maya: Start with 8 A100s (for dev->canary), 2x T4 for low-cost workloads. Might scale to 32 within 60 days.

sam: OK. I'll open support + service-quotas requests. Will also check ENI limits per AZ and request increase if needed.

lucas: I'll take GCP side. Need the billing account ID and the preferred project names. Also note: regional GPU quota requests are per-accelerator family and per-zone; expect 48–72h turnaround unless we escalate via partner channel.

lucas: Example quick commands to audit current quotas:
```
# list compute quotas for project
gcloud compute project-info describe --project=orchid-core --format="yaml(quotas)"
# list regional quotas
gcloud compute regions describe asia-southeast1 --project=orchid-core --format="yaml(quotas)"
```

sam: AWS snippet I'll use to request an increase (service-quotas / support ticket):
```
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A --desired-value 20 --region ap-southeast-1
# fallback: open a support case via console and reference "Orchid onboarding - GPU quota"
```

priya: I'll own IAM, billing link, and tag policy. Tagging convention we should enforce: `redwood:customer=orchid`, `redwood:env=prod`, `redwood:project=orchid-core`. We'll add a required tag policy in org/project level so no resources slip through.

priya: Checklist for IAM & billing:
- confirm billing account ID & attach to projects
- create service accounts with minimal roles (compute.admin only where needed)
- disable legacy project editors, enforce 2FA and SCIM for SSO
- KMS key creation per-cloud and give infra SA cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter

zoe: Cost note: 8x A100 (40GB/80GB depending) placeholder cost ~= expensive. Recommend we enable cost alerts and set a hard budget with notify + infra-runbook auto-suspend for non-prod if unexpected. Also tag mapping in billing export.

maya: Networking items — please validate ENI/IPs, NAT throughput (we'll likely need NAT gateway autoscale or NAT gateway & egress proxies in GCP), and reserved external IPs for control plane endpoints. Also need to pre-approve VPC peering routes and firewall baseline.

lucas: On GCP NAT: create Cloud NAT with enough IP addresses and set manual allocation for predictable egress. Also recommend Private Service Connect for control plane endpoints to avoid exposing APIs.

infra-bot: Automated ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-4721 — Labels: cross-cloud, quota, orchid. Assignees: sam, lucas, priya. SLA: standard (72h to respond).

sam: Adding AWS support case now. I'll paste the case number once created. If we need faster turnaround, ping @account-manager to escalate.

maya: Procurement note — customer expects Dedicated within 90 days if perf looks good. Keep note of reserved capacity options and tagging for chargebacks.

priya: For tagging and audit logs, I'll add a small policy doc and a terraform snippet for project bootstrap. Will share in this thread.

lucas: One more: GCP GPU quotas sometimes require an increased 'Internal IP' quota for subnets when adding nodes with GPUs — I'll check and request if needed.

zoe: Cost estimation quick ask — can infra run a baseline perf+cost for 8xA100 across the three clouds? We need it for the SOW.

maya: Yes — let's collect rough spot vs on-demand vs dedicated numbers. Lucas/sam/azure-owner please drop estimates by EOD tomorrow.

sam: AWS case opened: #1234567890. Requested 20 A100-equivalent (g5/metal fallback) in ap-southeast-1 and ENI increase to 200 per AZ. Reference INFRA-4721.

lucas: GCP quota request submitted via console. Request ID: Q-987654321. Asked for 16 A100s in asia-southeast1 and increased CPUS/GPUS per-zone.

priya: I've attached billing account to `orchid-core` and created `orchid-provisioning` SA with the minimal roles. Tags policy draft: `https://internal/docs/tags/orchid` (will upload).

maya: Great work — keep updates short here. If you hit a blocker, call it out and we can escalate. :thumbsup:
